Rae: Heads-up — VertexLabs says invoice INV-2026-1219 charged a duplicate batch on 2026-05-07. They flagged ~$3,200 extra. Can we check and process a one-time credit? @Diego @Nina

Diego: On it. @BillingBot invoice_lookup INV-2026-1219; usage_diff vertexlabs 2026-05-05 2026-05-09

BillingBot: INV-2026-1219 found. Billed: $12,800. Duplicate segments detected: 2026-05-07 batch-A and batch-A-retry both 64,000 tokens. Flag confidence: 0.86. Estimated overcharge: $3,200.

Rae: Recommend issue manual credit $3,200 and offer a $1,000 account concession as goodwill => total $4,200. GL: 7021-ADJ. Approvers: Diego (Sales), Nina (Billing), Harold (Accounting).

Diego: I approve.

Nina: Approved. I'll schedule manual_adjustment and tag vertexlabs.

Harold (Accounting): Approved. Please attach memo and record in FIN-4720. I'll post to ledger after memo.

Rae: @BillingBot create_adjustment INV-2026-1219 amount 4200 code 7021-ADJ note "duplicate batch + goodwill" tag: vertexlabs

BillingBot: Adjustment ADJ-2151113333-01 created. Status: pending_accounting.

Nina: Posted to ledger at 2026-06-01 11:05 UTC. Notifying CS to update customer.

Rae: Notified customer: "We've issued a $4,200 credit (ADJ-2151113333-01). You should see it on your next invoice."

Diego: Customer replied: "Thank you — confirmed."

Nina: Closing thread. Will add brief note to FIN-4720 about retry policy investigation.
